title: Toast and log use the singular for one customer moved
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the shop's own term A, due 45 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly one customer, customer C.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose "Net 30" in "Move To".
  4. Click "Move 1 Customer".
  5. Open the "⋯" page menu.
  6. Click "Audit Log".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The count reads "1 selected".
  • Button "Move 1 Customer".

Step 3:

  • The dropdown shows Net 30.

Step 4:

  • The toast reads "1 customer moved to Net 30."

Step 5:

  • The menu opens.

Step 6:

  • The newest row reads "1 customer from term A to Net 30", with no credit-limit line.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers), story SV-11681 (Story 12, Credit Terms audit log)

  • S4-R9: “On confirm, each ticked customer's credit term changes to the chosen term, the window closes, the page's Customers counts update, and a success toast shows "{n} customers moved to {term}." ("1 customer moved to {term}." for one).”
  • S12-R3 table, customers moved: “Customers are moved (Story 4: Move Customers) | "Customers moved" | "{n} customers from {from} to {to}" ("1 customer from {from} to {to}" for one), followed by "Credit limit set to $0 (previous limits are in each customer's note)" when the target is COD or Credit Hold”
